items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: I said to them, “You might as well let me do the social column, because I know all these guys like Squirrel Ashcraft and all these prominent people. And that’s how I got Lawrence — Benny Goodman in the trio... So I got Squirrel Ashcraft and all these — and we formed the Chicago Rhythm Club... I went

ctx.x: Yeah, it was back in his days, definitely. And so that was when I was first introduced to jazz. And right away, that was it. And that’s all I wanted to know about, and hear. And I didn’t know what the instruments were or what I was listening to, but I always knew what I was listening to. And years later I said oh that’s Benny Goodman. And then I’d say oh that’s Bunny Berrigan. I knew all those instruments but I didn’t know what they were. I wasn’t a trained musician. But happily I think I might say, like many…
And eventually you were able to tell one player from another.
